title: Arrows
heading: Arrow icons
intro: Arrow and chevron icons for navigation, pagination, sorting controls and dropdowns. The set has straight arrows in eight directions, return arrows that turn a corner, and single and double chevrons for each side.

title: Actions
heading: Action icons
intro: Action icons for the buttons most interfaces need: add, remove, close, copy, share, download, upload, search and delete. Most of them sit inside a button or a toolbar, so they are drawn to read clearly at 16 and 24 pixels.

title: Editing and text
heading: Editing and text icons
intro: Editing icons for text editors, design tools and content forms. The set covers writing, undo and redo, text alignment in six directions, type, contrast and design system components.

title: Layout and settings
heading: Layout and settings icons
intro: Layout icons for app shells, dashboards and settings screens. They cover menus, sidebars, grids, lists, tables, layers, drag handles, filters, sorting, toggles and the settings gear.

title: Files and folders
heading: File and folder icons
intro: File and folder icons for document lists, file browsers and upload fields. The set has documents and folders with add and remove variants, plus an archive box, a package, a book, a bookmark and a paperclip for attachments.

title: Communication
heading: Communication icons
intro: Communication icons for messaging, email, notifications and contact details. The set covers mail, an inbox, a send arrow, a chat bubble, a phone, the at sign, notification bells, a globe, a map pin and wifi.

title: Media
heading: Media icons
intro: Media icons for audio and video players, cameras and photo galleries. The set has play, pause, stop and a combined play and pause control, a camera, a video camera, a picture, microphone and volume icons with muted variants, and an exposure control.

title: People and reactions
heading: People and reaction icons
intro: People icons for accounts, profiles, teams and member lists, and reaction icons for feedback and ratings. The set covers one user, a user being added or removed, a group, the accessibility symbol, a smile, thumbs up and down, a heart and a star.

title: Development
heading: Developer icons
intro: Developer icons for documentation sites, dev tools and technical dashboards. The set covers code, a terminal, curly braces, a bug, the command key, a CPU, a database, a server, a plug, the hash sign and four git icons for branch, commit, merge and pull request.

title: Status and security
heading: Status and security icons
intro: Status icons for alerts, validation messages and empty states, and security icons for login and privacy settings. The set has warning, error, information, help and success markers, a loading spinner, a flag, a shield, a key, a lock and an unlock, and show and hide eyes for password fields.

title: Business and charts
heading: Business and chart icons
intro: Business icons for dashboards, reports, stores and landing pages. The set covers bar, line and pie charts, trend arrows in both directions, coins, a credit card, a shopping cart, a price tag, an office building, a rocket, a lightbulb and a sparkle.

title: Time and weather
heading: Time and weather icons
intro: Time icons for calendars, schedules and activity logs, and weather icons for forecasts and theme switches. The set has a calendar, a calendar with an add mark, a clock, a history clock, a sun, a moon, a cloud, rain, a rainbow, a water drop and a lightning bolt.
